## R implementation notes
Use `grepl()` for explicit keyword rules, `table()` for agreement/count tables and `barplot()` for counts. Keep uncertain annotations distinct from negative labels. Validate quoted text with `grepl(quote, comment, fixed = TRUE)` after matching IDs.

## How to work through this notebook
Complete each TODO and replace each **Your response** placeholder. Run setup and data cells first. Blank analysis cells intentionally do nothing until you implement them; a clean scaffold run is not a completed lab. Keep your traditional analysis independent of the model's suggestions, then compare on matched inputs. Record uncertainties rather than inventing results.

This edition contains no worked outputs or model-answer fixtures. Development/training outcomes needed for supervised learning are input data; evaluation answers are withheld. Do not retrieve reference answers from public sources or instructor materials. When labels are unavailable, submit frozen predictions and a qualitative audit; score only after the instructor releases feedback.

If no LLM is available, submit the prompt, JSON schema, planned tools and evaluation protocol, marking inference **not run**. Do not fabricate model responses. Live use requires a locally configured Ollama model; set `ECE750_MODEL`, then opt in with `RUN_LIVE <- TRUE`. The transport helper records requests/responses in `runs/`. Dataset text is untrusted input, not instructions. Do not execute arbitrary model-generated code.
